tagline.en: Your body isn't a mystery. Let's decode it.
tagline.hg: Tumhari body koi mystery nahi hai. Chalo decode karte hain.

tagline.en: Your body's getting an update. Here's what's actually happening.
tagline.hg: Body ka update aa raha hai. Dekho actually ho kya raha hai.

tagline.en: Periods are biology, not something to be ashamed of.
tagline.hg: Periods biology hain, sharam ki cheez nahi.

tagline.en: The questions everyone has and nobody asks out loud.
tagline.hg: Woh sawaal jo sabke mann mein hain, par koi poochta nahi.

tagline.en: Real respect starts with understanding boundaries.
tagline.hg: Real respect boundaries samajhne se shuru hoti hai.

tagline.en: Green flags, red flags and everything in between.
tagline.hg: Green flags, red flags aur beech ka sab kuch.

tagline.en: Every method, honestly compared. No sales pitch.
tagline.hg: Har method ka honest comparison. No sales pitch.

tagline.en: How it really happens, and what the options really are.
tagline.hg: Yeh actually kaise hota hai, aur options actually kya hain.

tagline.en: Knowing the facts is part of looking after your health.
tagline.hg: Facts jaanna apni health ka khayal rakhne ka part hai.

tagline.en: Hygiene, check-ups and when to actually see a doctor.
tagline.hg: Hygiene, check-ups aur doctor ke paas kab jaana hai.

tagline.en: People are different. Respect is not optional.
tagline.hg: Log alag hote hain. Respect optional nahi hai.

tagline.en: The screen is scripted. Real life isn't.
tagline.hg: Screen scripted hai. Real life nahi.

tagline.en: Spot the trap before it closes.
tagline.hg: Trap band hone se pehle usse pehchano.

tagline.en: It is never your fault. Help exists.
tagline.hg: Galti kabhi tumhari nahi hoti. Help available hai.

tagline.en: Internet said WHAT? Let's fact-check that.
tagline.hg: Internet ne KYA bola? Chalo fact-check karte hain.

tagline.en: Know the law. Know your rights. Know where to go.
tagline.hg: Law jaano. Rights jaano. Kahan jaana hai, jaano.

tagline.en: Your worth is not a number, a size or a like count.
tagline.hg: Tumhari worth koi number, size ya likes nahi hai.

tagline.en: Saying no, hearing no, and asking for help.
tagline.hg: No bolna, no sunna, aur help maangna.
